subject: per-dy
title: PER.DY.------C.INFO.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-21 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's question about the next cycle: 'In the coming cycle we will be forced to decide the nature of the next continuum of applied progressionalism — that being, will we move to perceive of progressionalism only by what this consideration implies for our isolated national interest, or will we view this consideration with respect for its composite implications.' PER-DY (perception dynamics) is crossed with C-INFO (composite information): the question is what perception-dynamics produces when crossed with composite-information — perception-dynamics being the chapter's organizing concept, composite-information being the integrated information-position the next cycle requires. C-INFO sits at the top. MT-INFO (multi-information) branches from the main line; from its line runs a path to EXB-H-OR (establishing high order), which leads to INFO-DE-B (information degree basis) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). AFI (affinity insight) sits below the main line and AF-CY at the bottom, neither with a drawn line or dot. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) sits centrally. TRS (transition) and ACT (activism) anchor the lower-left; ACT branches from the TRS line, and ALT-C-PROG (alternative composite progressionalism) rises from the ACT line.
